title: JobEnvelope
description: Versioned, immutable transport envelope for durable job messaging (§4.1, §12.2). No secrets or raw payment data (Inv-12); payloads reference authoritative records by ID.

message_type.description: Explicit schema version in format <domain>.<event>.<verb>.vN (e.g. booking.finalize.requested.v1).

occurred_at.description: Wall-clock timestamp when the event occurred (ISO 8601 with offset).

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across all messages in an operation chain.

causation_id.description: message_id of the direct cause of this message (optional).

intent_revision.description: Revision of the intent at time of dispatch (optional).

attempt_hint.description: Advisory attempt number; authoritative count lives in workflow_attempts/scheduled_jobs (§15.2).

payload.description: Event-specific payload; sanitised — no secrets or PAN (Inv-12). References authoritative records by ID.
